content.title: Validate dual-format documentation generation
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/docs-generation.md

Validate the documentation generation setup after library-release completes configuration (issue mpctzf23nq).

Check:
1. 'bun run docs:html' generates complete HTML API docs to docs/html/ at repo root
2. 'bun run docs:md' generates complete Markdown API docs to docs/md/ at repo root
3. 'bun run docs' generates both formats
4. 'bun run docs:check' validates without writing files
5. Both formats include all public API (Tracker methods, types, errors)
6. Markdown output is concise — no breadcrumbs, no page headers, flat structure
7. 'bun run quality' still passes (typecheck, lint, test:coverage)
8. Old docs-html/ inside packages/library/ is removed
9. Content parity between HTML and Markdown (same API coverage)

Report any issues found. Do not fix — only report.

content.reason: Blocker issue mpctzf23nq transitioned to done

content.content:
## Validation Report: Dual-Format Documentation Generation

### Acceptance Criteria Results

| # | Criterion | Status | Notes |
|---|-----------|--------|-------|
| 1 | `bun run docs:html` generates HTML to `docs/html/` at repo root | ✅ PASS | 2 classes, 29 interfaces, 24 types, index.html, hierarchy.html |
| 2 | `bun run docs:md` generates Markdown to `docs/md/` at repo root | ✅ PASS | 2 classes, 29 interfaces, 24 type-aliases, README.md |
| 3 | `bun run docs` generates both formats | ✅ PASS | Runs docs:html && docs:md in sequence |
| 4 | `bun run docs:check` validates without writing | ✅ PASS | Runs `typedoc --emit none` |
| 5 | Both formats include all public API | ✅ PASS | Content parity confirmed: same 2 classes, 29 interfaces, 24 types in both |
| 6 | Markdown is concise (no breadcrumbs/headers) | ✅ PASS | No breadcrumbs, no page headers, flat structure per category |
| 7 | `docs/` in root `.gitignore` | ✅ PASS | Entry present |
| 8 | `bun run quality` still passes | ✅ PASS | 573 tests, 0 fail, 2009 assertions, typecheck + lint clean |
| 9 | Old `docs-html/` inside `packages/library/` removed | ⚠️ FAIL | Directory still exists with stale HTML content |
| 10 | GitHub Actions deploys from `docs/html/` | ✅ PASS | `upload-pages-artifact` uses `path: docs/html` |

### Issues Found (1)

**AC9: Old `docs-html/` not cleaned up**
- Location: `packages/library/docs-html/` — contains 9 items (stale HTML docs from before the migration)
- Expected: Directory should be removed per spec
- Impact: Low — doesn't affect functionality, but creates confusion about which docs directory is canonical
- Recommendation: library-release agent should delete `packages/library/docs-html/`

### Summary

**9 of 10 acceptance criteria PASS.** The setup is fully functional — both HTML and Markdown generation work correctly, content parity is confirmed, and the release workflow is updated. One minor cleanup item remains: the old `docs-html/` directory inside `packages/library/` was not removed during the migration.
